cat > /app/tmp/t/test_proto4.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/tmp/t")
from harness import *

ok = True
# convenience: A key installed at event 0
def A0(frames, pn=0, t=1, auth=True, size=1200, level="A"):
    return [key(0,"A","install"), dg(t,size,[pkt(level,pn,auth,frames)])]

# ---- STREAM basics
ok &= check("stream basic", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,None,False,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# zero-length STREAM at nonzero offset counts toward highest
ok &= check("stream zero-len offset", CFG(), A0([STR(0,5,"",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 5,
        [st(0,5,None,False,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# uni stream direction (mod4=2)
ok &= check("stream uni", CFG(), A0([STR(2,0,"61",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 1,
        [st(2,1,None,False,False,"61")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# wrong directions
for sid, name in [(1,"sid1"),(3,"sid3"),(5,"sid5"),(7,"sid7")]:
    ok &= check("stream dir "+name, CFG(), A0([STR(sid,0,"",False)]),
        RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,0)],
            conn_closed("STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [],
            [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# stream limits: floor(sid/4)+1 <= limit
ok &= check("stream limit bidi", CFG(max_streams_bidi=1), A0([STR(4,0,"",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("stream limit bidi ok", CFG(max_streams_bidi=2), A0([STR(4,0,"",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 0,
        [st(4,0,None,False,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("stream limit uni", CFG(max_streams_uni=1), A0([STR(6,0,"",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("stream limit 0", CFG(max_streams_bidi=0, max_streams_uni=0), A0([STR(0,0,"",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# direction check precedes limit check
ok &= check("dir before limit", CFG(max_streams_bidi=0, max_streams_uni=0), A0([STR(1,0,"",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("STREAM_STATE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# implicit lower streams do not create entries
ok &= check("implicit streams no entry", CFG(max_streams_bidi=4), A0([STR(12,0,"61",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 1,
        [st(12,1,None,False,False,"61")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# multiple streams sorted by id in output
ok &= check("streams sorted", CFG(), A0([STR(8,0,"",False),STR(0,0,"",False),STR(2,0,"",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 0,
        [st(0,0),st(2,0),st(8,0)], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# ---- final size semantics
ok &= check("fin sets final_size", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",True)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,2,False,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# end > final_size -> FINAL_SIZE_ERROR
ok &= check("end beyond final", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",True),STR(0,0,"6364",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# fin with end != final_size -> error
ok &= check("fin mismatch", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",True),STR(0,2,"63",True)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# retransmission below final size, no fin -> ok
ok &= check("retransmit below final", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",True),STR(0,0,"6162",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,2,False,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# fin=true and end < highest -> error
ok &= check("fin below highest", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"61626364",False),STR(0,0,"61",True)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# fin=true and end == highest -> ok
ok &= check("fin at highest", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(0,2,"",True)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 2,
        [st(0,2,2,False,False,"6162")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# fin=true and end > highest -> ok
ok &= check("fin above highest", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"61",False),STR(0,4,"6263",True)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 6,
        [st(0,6,6,False,False,"61")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# zero-length fin at 0 on empty stream
ok &= check("empty fin", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"",True)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 0,
        [st(0,0,0,False,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

# ---- flow control
ok &= check("stream flow", CFG(max_stream_data=4), A0([STR(0,0,"61626364",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("stream flow exact", CFG(max_stream_data=4), A0([STR(0,0,"616263",False),STR(0,3,"64",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 4,
        [st(0,4,None,False,False,"61626364")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# retransmitted frame with end > max_stream_data still errors even if highest is larger
ok &= check("stream flow retransmit", CFG(max_stream_data=4), A0([STR(0,0,"61626364",False),STR(0,0,"61626364",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# connection flow control across streams
ok &= check("conn flow", CFG(max_data=4, max_stream_data=32), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(4,0,"6364",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("conn flow exact", CFG(max_data=4, max_stream_data=32), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(4,0,"6364",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("conn flow ok", CFG(max_data=4, max_stream_data=32), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(4,0,"63",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 3,
        [st(0,2,None,False,False,"6162"),st(4,1,None,False,False,"63")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# holes are not charged twice; retransmission of same offset not re-charged
ok &= check("no double charge", CFG(max_data=6, max_stream_data=32), A0([STR(0,4,"6162",False),STR(0,4,"6162",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 6,
        [st(0,6,None,False,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# large sparse offsets kept exact
ok &= check("sparse exact", CFG(max_data=4611686018427387903, max_stream_data=65536),
        A0([STR(0,65535,"61",False)])),
    None if False else RES("t",[pres(1,0,"accepted","OK",1)], conn_open(1), KEYS(a="live"), 65536,
        [st(0,65536,None,False,False,"")], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# stream end overflow
ok &= check("stream overflow", CFG(), A0([STR(0,4611686018427387903,"61",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,0)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,0)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
# check order: overflow before final-size, flow after final-size
ok &= check("overflow before final", CFG(), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",True),STR(0,4611686018427387903,"61",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("final before flow", CFG(max_stream_data=2), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",True),STR(0,0,"616263",True)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FINAL_SIZE_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))
ok &= check("flow before overlap", CFG(max_stream_data=2, overlap="reject"), A0([STR(0,0,"6162",False),STR(0,0,"ffff",False)]),
    RES("t",[pres(1,0,"error","FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,1)],
        conn_closed("FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR",1,src(1,0,1)), KEYS(a="live"), 0, [], [cr("I",0),cr("H",0),cr("A",0)]))

print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_proto4.py 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ALL PASS|SOME FAILED" -A2
